title: Elevated levels of MMP12 sourced from macrophages are associated with poor prognosis in urothelial bladder cancer.
summary: Swedish discovery plasma cohort and an independent UK validation cohort are compared; MMP12 is associated with shorter overall survival after adjustment.
ai_technology: Random-survival-forest analysis identifies plasma MMP12 as a prognostic marker in urothelial bladder cancer; targeted proteomics and macrophage analyses connect the signal to a cellular source.

evidence.tested: Swedish discovery plasma cohort and an independent UK validation cohort are compared; MMP12 is associated with shorter overall survival after adjustment.
evidence.unknown: Observational association does not establish causality or therapeutic value.
evidence.ai_role: Random-survival-forest analysis identifies plasma MMP12 as a prognostic marker in urothelial bladder cancer; targeted proteomics and macrophage analyses connect the signal to a cellular source.
